# Docit Knowledge Base — pgvector + Bedrock embeddings for hybrid search & RAG

- **Kind**: feature
- **Date**: 2026-07-28
- **Requested by**: Ian

## Description

Extend docit from a documentation product into a knowledge base: semantic
search over books/pages powered by pgvector and AWS Bedrock embeddings, plus a
retrieval API the assistant app can consume for RAG.

## Context

docit (Book → Page → PageRevision, markdown content) has no search today — not
even `SEARCH_FIELDS` on its RestMeta. Discovery is limited to browsing the page
tree. Meanwhile the assistant app has agent/memory/skills services but no
retrieval layer to ground answers in workspace documentation. One knowledge
service solves both.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Provider-agnostic embeddings helper (`mojo/helpers/embeddings.py`) with a
      Bedrock backend as the first implementation — Titan Text Embeddings V2
      (`amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0`), configurable dimensions. New
      `BEDROCK_*` settings family (region, model id, dims).
- [ ] `PageChunk` model: pages split on heading boundaries; each chunk stores a
      pgvector `VectorField` + content hash. (Re-)embedding runs async via the
      jobs app on page save; unchanged chunks (hash match) are skipped.
- [ ] Hybrid search: pgvector cosine similarity fused with Postgres full-text
      (`tsvector`) rank — handles both semantic queries and exact identifiers.
- [ ] REST search endpoint on docit; results respect book/page visibility
      (`is_active`, `is_published`) and docit permission conventions.
- [ ] Knowledge/retrieval service (query → ranked chunks with page/book refs)
      exposed so the assistant app can register it as a tool.
- [ ] Graceful degradation behind a feature flag: without pgvector/Bedrock the
      endpoint still works FTS-only. No hard dependency for consumers that
      don't enable the KB.
- [ ] Test infra: pgvector extension available in the test Postgres,
      `bin/create_testproject` handles the migration; tests mock Bedrock (no
      live AWS calls).
- [ ] Docs in both tracks (django_developer + web_developer) and CHANGELOG.

## Investigation

- **What exists**:
  - `mojo/apps/docit/models/` — `book.py`, `page.py` (hierarchical, markdown
    `content`), `page_revision.py`, `asset.py`. No search anywhere.
  - `mojo/helpers/llm.py` — Anthropic-API LLM helper (ask/call/model
    discovery). No embeddings.
  - `mojo/apps/assistant/services/` — agent/context/memory/skills/tools; no
    retrieval layer.
  - `mojo/helpers/aws/` + `mojo/apps/aws/` — boto3 already a dependency;
    currently email-focused. No Bedrock usage yet (this is the first).
  - `mojo/apps/jobs/` — background job runner for the async embed pipeline.
- **What changes**: new embeddings helper; new `PageChunk` model + migration;
  embed-on-save job wiring in docit; knowledge/search service in
  `docit/services/`; REST search endpoint; assistant tool registration;
  settings + docs.
- **Constraints**:
  - `pgvector` Python package is a new dependency; the Postgres `vector`
    extension must exist in dev/test/prod DBs — deployment + `create_testproject`
    impact.
  - Embedding dimensionality is fixed per column — switching models later
    requires a re-embed migration; store model id + dims alongside vectors.
  - Bedrock calls cost money and need AWS credentials — embed async, batch
    where possible, never block a page save on AWS.
  - Feature must be opt-in per deployment (django-mojo is a library).
- **Related files**: `mojo/apps/docit/models/page.py`,
  `mojo/apps/docit/services/docit.py`, `mojo/helpers/llm.py`,
  `mojo/helpers/aws/`, `mojo/apps/assistant/services/tools/`,
  `bin/create_testproject`.
- **Out of scope**: embedding non-docit content (fileman, chat, etc.);
  frontend/UI work (web-mojo side); additional embedding backends beyond the
  Bedrock implementation (interface leaves room, nothing else built);
  LLM answer synthesis over results (retrieval only — the assistant composes
  answers).

## Plan

### Objective

Authenticated hybrid search over docit content — pgvector cosine similarity
(Bedrock Titan V2 embeddings) fused with Postgres full-text rank — exposed as
`GET/POST /api/docit/search` and as an assistant tool, with chunk-level
indexing kept fresh by async jobs. Deployments that don't opt in keep a
working FTS-only search with zero new schema or dependencies.

### Design decisions (resolved)

1. **Opt-in via a separate Django app `mojo.apps.docit_kb`** — all vector
   schema (PageChunk + `CREATE EXTENSION vector`) lives in its migrations.
   INSTALLED_APPS is the feature flag (it's a per-consumer literal list —
   `bin/create_testproject` heredoc is the canonical copy). No conditional
   migrations, no risk to existing docit consumers: `mojo.apps.docit` itself
   gets **no schema change**. Rejected: vector column on a docit model
   (breaks `migrate` for consumers without the extension); runtime-guarded
   DDL (fragile, fights Django's SELECT-all-fields ORM).
2. **Fallback search lives in docit proper** using
   `django.contrib.postgres.search` expression annotations (ship with
   Django; work WITHOUT adding `django.contrib.postgres` to INSTALLED_APPS —
   verified: nothing in the repo uses FTS today). Page-level
   SearchVector/SearchRank/SearchHeadline, computed on the fly. No stored
   tsvector column, no index — docs search corpus is small; revisit only if
   real deployments prove it slow.
3. **Provider-agnostic embeddings in `mojo/helpers/embeddings.py`** with two
   providers: `bedrock` (default; Titan Text Embeddings V2) and `mock`
   (deterministic hash-based vectors — used by tests AND useful for offline
   dev). Mock-as-provider solves the testit server-isolation problem:
   `mock.patch` can't reach the test server process, but
   `th.server_settings(EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER="mock")` can.
4. **Embedding dimension fixed at 1024** (Titan V2 default) in the
   PageChunk column. `EMBEDDINGS_DIM` setting exists but changing it
   requires a migration + full re-embed; the embed pipeline refuses (logs
   error, stores no vector) on dimension mismatch rather than corrupting.
5. **Jobs are addressed by dotted path, handlers are plain functions**
   (mojo/apps/jobs pattern — no registration). Core embed logic is a
   synchronous service function `embed_page_now(page)`; the job handler
   wraps it. Tests call the sync function directly (no jobs worker
   dependency); production goes through `jobs.publish` on the default
   channel.
6. **RRF fusion in Python** (k=60): two capped ORM queries (CosineDistance
   top-3×limit, SearchRank top-3×limit), merge by chunk id. No raw SQL.
7. **Endpoint auth = `@md.requires_auth()`** — matches docit's effective
   visibility: `VIEW_PERMS=['all']` is authenticated-only in practice
   (verified in `mojo/models/rest.py` — anonymous requests 401 at the
   terminal fallthrough; docs/django_developer/rest/permissions.md line 140
   overstates it as public). Same pattern as docit's existing
   `rest/render.py`.
8. **Verified locally**: test Postgres has pgvector 0.8.2 available
   (`pg_available_extensions`); the `pgvector` Python package is NOT in the
   venv yet (dep work below).

### Settings (all read via `settings.get`, hot-reloadable)

| Setting | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER` | `"bedrock"` | `"bedrock"` \| `"mock"` |
| `EMBEDDINGS_DIM` | `1024` | must match PageChunk column; guard on mismatch |
| `BEDROCK_REGION` | falls back to `AWS_REGION` | |
| `BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL` | `"amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0"` | |

Credentials: existing `AWS_KEY`/`AWS_SECRET` via the
`mojo/helpers/aws/client.py` session-factory pattern (late-bound at call
time — NOT the import-time singleton pattern `s3.py` uses).

### Implementation steps (ordered)

1. **Baseline** (`.claude/rules/build-baseline.md`): `bin/run_tests --agent`,
   record totals from `var/test_failures.json` before any edit.
2. **Dependencies** — `pyproject.toml`: new
   `[project.optional-dependencies] kb = ["pgvector>=0.4"]`; add
   `pgvector` to `[dependency-groups] dev` (test server imports it);
   `uv sync`.
3. **`mojo/helpers/embeddings.py`** — public API: `embed_texts(texts)`,
   `embed_query(text)`, `is_available()`, `get_provider()`. BedrockProvider:
   boto3 `bedrock-runtime` client from the aws session factory; Titan V2
   invokes are one text per call — loop the batch; catch
   `ClientError` throttling and re-raise (jobs retry/backoff handles it).
   MockProvider: seeded-hash deterministic unit vectors, dimension from
   `EMBEDDINGS_DIM`. No type hints; `logit` for logging.
4. **New app `mojo/apps/docit_kb/`**:
   - `apps.py` (label `docit_kb`), `__init__.py`.
   - `models/page_chunk.py` — `PageChunk`: `page` FK
     (`docit.Page`, CASCADE, related_name `chunks`), `position` (int),
     `heading` (Char 300, blank — breadcrumb like "Install > Quickstart"),
     `content` (Text), `content_hash` (Char 64, sha256, db_index),
     `embedding` (`pgvector.django.VectorField(dimensions=1024, null=True)`),
     `embed_model` (Char 100, blank, default ""), standard
     `created`/`modified`. `unique_together = ['page', 'position']`. Minimal
     RestMeta (VIEW_PERMS/SAVE_PERMS `['manage_docit']`, basic graph) — no
     URL is registered for it; internal model.
   - `migrations/0001_initial.py` — `VectorExtension()` +
     CreateModel + `HnswIndex(fields=['embedding'],
     opclasses=['vector_cosine_ops'])`.
   - `services/chunker.py` — `chunk_markdown(content)` → ordered list of
     `objict(heading, content, content_hash, position)`. Split on `#`–`###`
     heading lines, carry heading breadcrumb; hard-split chunks over ~4000
     chars at paragraph boundaries; page with no headings = one chunk.
     Deterministic.
   - `services/knowledge.py` —
     `embed_page_now(page)`: chunk → diff against existing rows by
     (position, content_hash) → delete stale, create new (embedding null) →
     embed all null-embedding rows if `is_available()` (dimension guard) →
     stamp `embed_model`. Idempotent; re-run only embeds nulls.
     `search(query, book=None, limit=10)`: base qs filtered
     `page__is_published=True, page__book__is_active=True` (+ book id-or-slug
     filter); vector leg only if provider available; FTS leg via
     SearchVector('heading','content') + websearch SearchQuery + SearchRank;
     RRF fuse; return objicts (page_id, page_slug, page_title, book_id,
     book_slug, heading, snippet ≤500 chars, score). Also
     `reindex_book(book)` → per-page `jobs.publish`.
   - `asyncjobs.py` — `embed_page(job)`: payload `{"page_id": N}`; missing
     page = clean no-op; calls `embed_page_now`.
5. **docit wiring** (all guarded by
   `django.apps.apps.is_installed("mojo.apps.docit_kb")`):
   - `models/page.py` `save()`: after super().save(), try/except
     `jobs.publish("mojo.apps.docit_kb.asyncjobs.embed_page",
     {"page_id": self.pk}, max_retries=2)` — a failed publish must never
     break a page save (log error). Publish on every save; the hash diff in
     the job makes unchanged content free.
   - `models/book.py`: `POST_SAVE_ACTIONS = ["reindex"]` +
     `on_action_reindex(self, value)` → `reindex_book` (discrete action key
     per repo convention; runs under Book SAVE_PERMS =
     manage_docit/docs/owner — correct gate).
   - `services/search.py` (new, in docit) — `search_pages(query, book=None,
     limit=10)`: page-level FTS fallback with SearchHeadline snippet, same
     visibility filters, same result shape (heading empty).
   - `rest/search.py` (new) —
     `@md.URL('search')` + `@md.requires_auth()`; accepts GET or POST;
     `q` (falls back to `search` param) required else 400; optional `book`,
     `limit` (int, clamp 1–50, default 10). Dispatch: docit_kb installed →
     `knowledge.search` (mode `"hybrid"` or `"fts"` when provider
     unavailable) else `search_pages` (mode `"pages"`). Returns
     `{"results": [...], "mode": ..., "count": N}`. Register in
     `rest/__init__.py`.
   - `assistant_tools.py` (new; autodiscovered as module name
     `assistant_tools`) — `@tool(name="search_docs", domain="docit",
     permission="all", mutates=False, input_schema={query required, book,
     limit})`, handler `(params, user)` → same dispatch → compact results.
     Add `"docit"` entry to `DOMAIN_DESCRIPTIONS` in
     `mojo/apps/assistant/__init__.py`.
6. **Test infra** — `bin/create_testproject`: add `"mojo.apps.docit_kb"` to
   the INSTALLED_APPS heredoc; add a pre-flight check
   (`SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name='vector'`) with a
   clear install hint on failure. Re-run `bin/create_testproject`
   (schema change → mandatory, per core rules).
7. **Tests** — `tests/test_docit/knowledge.py` (setup deletes its own
   fixtures first; every assert carries a message):
   - chunker: heading split, breadcrumbs, oversize split, no-heading page,
     hash/position determinism.
   - `embed_page_now` with mock provider (in-process): rows created;
     re-run with unchanged content re-embeds nothing (hash skip); edited
     content drops stale rows; provider-off run stores null embeddings;
     dimension-mismatch guard skips vectors.
   - hybrid `search` (in-process): semantic-ish hit via mock vectors + exact
     identifier hit via FTS both surface; unpublished page and
     inactive-book chunks never returned; book filter by id and slug.
   - REST via `opts.client` + `th.server_settings(EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER="mock")`:
     200 shape for authenticated, 401 anonymous, 400 missing q, limit clamp;
     provider-off server → `mode` degrades (no 500).
   - docit fallback `search_pages` service tested in-process (the
     app-not-installed dispatch branch can't be exercised against the live
     test server — INSTALLED_APPS is fixed there; the service itself is the
     load-bearing part).
   - Run `bin/run_tests --agent -t test_docit.knowledge`, then the default
     suite; compare to baseline (green → green).
8. **Docs + changelog** —
   `docs/django_developer/docit/README.md` (+ new `knowledge.md`: enabling
   the app, settings, provider interface, backfill/reindex, dimension
   caveat); `docs/web_developer/docit/README.md` (endpoint params/response/
   auth, reindex action, assistant tool); settings-reference doc gains the
   `EMBEDDINGS_*`/`BEDROCK_EMBED_*` family (locate via
   `git show ba69c86f --stat`); both README indexes; `CHANGELOG.md`.
9. **Close-out** — commit by explicit pathspec; spawn test-runner,
   docs-updater, security-review agents (django-mojo-build-conventions);
   fold findings; stage → review/done.

### Edge cases & error handling

- Empty/whitespace query → 400. Query over ~1k chars → truncate for
  embedding (Titan 8k-token limit is far above any sane search query).
- Bedrock throttling/outage mid-batch → exception propagates → jobs
  retry/backoff; already-embedded rows untouched (idempotent re-run).
- Publish-hook failure (Redis down) → caught + logged, page save succeeds.
- Deleted page/book → CASCADE clears chunks. Unpublish/deactivate → chunks
  stay but query-time filters hide them (cheap, reversible).
- Two search legs returning disjoint sets → RRF handles; zero results →
  empty list, not error.
- Anonymous user → 401 (fail closed); no secrets or unpublished content in
  any result path.
